source.raw_extract: Important: New deadline for the 2027 EPFL Master Excellence Fellowship. Applicants must submit their application within the first application window for a Master's program: – December 15 for applications submitted via IS-Academia. – January 31 for EPFL students applying for a consecutive Master's degree. More details in Application & deadlines section.

source.notes: Two official EPFL pages agree and neither states a calendar year. Corroborating official page https://www.epfl.ch/education/master/master-excellence-fellowships/how-to-apply/ (fetched) states verbatim: 'Deadline: December 15. Only applications that are paid for and validated by 15 December at the latest will be considered for the Excellence Fellowship.' and for internal EPFL candidates 'Deadline: January 31 (application and recommendation letters)'. Because no year is published anywhere, no YYYY-MM-DD can be written without inference, so precision is capped at month and deadline_date stays null. NOTE: the shard's cached deadline_display ('December 15 (1st round), March 31 (2nd round)') is contradicted by the live pages - there is no March 31 second round any more; the second route is January 31 for EPFL internal candidates.

corroborating.raw_extract: Deadline: December 15. Only applications that are paid for and validated by 15 December at the latest will be considered for the Excellence Fellowship.

source.raw_extract: The following scholarships are awarded to incoming first-year students with non-U.S. residency status. Unless otherwise noted, the application for admission is all that you need to submit in order to be considered for each award. Please note: - Applying by the Nov. 1 early action deadline guarantees a decision by January 15. - Only a limited number of students who are considered will receive offers for any of the following scholarships. ... Scholarship decisions for the MSU Non-resident Scholarship will be released by mid-February.

source.notes: These MSU international scholarships have no dedicated application deadline of their own: the official page states the admission application is all that is required. The only date-bearing deadline named on the scholarship page is the Nov. 1 early action admission deadline. Two further official MSU admissions pages fetched make the scholarship linkage explicit but also show there is no single closing date: https://admissions.msu.edu/apply/international says 'The fall 2027 first-year application is now open. Apply by Nov. 1 for early action and maximum scholarship consideration.' and https://admissions.msu.edu/apply/international/dates-and-deadlines says 'Early action - Nov. 1 ... automatically ensures maximum consideration for all scholarship opportunities' and 'Regular decision - April 1 (Priority: Feb. 1) ... Students who apply for regular admission will still be automatically considered for any remaining awards/scholarships.' No official page states a calendar year for any of these dates, so deadline_date stays null and precision is capped at month. Confidence LOW because Nov. 1 is an admissions deadline used here as a consideration window rather than a scholarship closing date.

records.title: MIT Undergraduate Need-Based Financial Aid and MIT Scholarship for International Students

source.as_of: live page; describes the standing annual cycle and publishes no calendar year
source.raw_extract:
To apply for financial aid, all students must submit the CSS Profile and parental tax returns or income documentation through IDOC by the following deadlines. Domestic students must also submit the FAFSA. Application deadlines are the same for both domestic and international students.

Cycle | Application deadline | Offers released
Early Action | November 30 | Mid-January
Regular Action | February 15 | Mid-March
Transfer | February 15 | After admission decisions

You can manage your aid application documents and access your offer through the MIT Application Portal until mid-May.
source.notes: The shard's official_source_url https://sfs.mit.edu/undergraduate-students/apply-for-aid/international (fetched) contains no dates at all; it defers to this linked page via its 'Aid deadlines and process' navigation entry. The dates are published as a standing annual cycle table with month and day only and no year anywhere, so per the brief this is ANNUAL/recurring and is never converted to a calendar date. The page states explicitly that the deadlines are the same for international as for domestic students, which is why the international page carries no separate date. Two distinct annual dates exist (Early Action November 30 and Regular/Transfer February 15); November 30 is the earliest and is reported as the display value with February 15 noted.
